name: Satvora AI
tagline: AI Health Coach, Multimodal Food Scanner & Calorie Tracker
summary: Satvora AI is an evidence-informed AI nutrition companion and food photo scanner for Android. Built specifically with Indian dietary diversity in mind, it provides multimodal meal recognition, macro logging, and conversational wellness guidance with an offline-first privacy architecture.
highlights: Multimodal meal scanning and portion estimation from camera photos
Comprehensive Indian and regional food nutritional taxonomy (supports 14 Indian languages)
Strict privacy-first architecture: core nutrition logs and user diary stored locally on-device
Evidence-informed dietary guidance with zero medical or cure claims
Active closed testing on Google Play with ongoing beta tester feedback cycles
architecture: Camera / Gallery Input → Multimodal Neural Vision Pipeline → Nutritional Taxonomy Database → On-Device Local Journal Store (Room) → Interactive Wellness Coach Dialogue
testingDetails: Currently in closed testing under Google Play developer test tracks (r/AndroidAppTesters, r/GooglePlayClosedTest). Focus areas include OCR reliability, regional Indian dish accuracy, and battery consumption optimization.

name: KinotiX: 4K Live & 3D Wallpaper
tagline: Interactive 4K Wallpaper Engine with 3D Parallax & Fluid Dynamics
summary: KinotiX is an Android live wallpaper engine published on Google Play. It transforms device home and lock screens with multi-layer 3D gyro parallax depth, touch-reactive interactive fluid physics, and curated AMOLED-optimized 4K visual themes.
highlights: Real-time 3D parallax depth shifting using hardware accelerometer and gyroscope sensor input
Touch-reactive fluid dynamics engine with customizable ripples and particle simulations
Deep black AMOLED-optimized themes to reduce OLED screen battery consumption
Transparent live camera background mode for augmented visual perspective
Battery-efficient lifecycle management: rendering automatically suspends when screen is locked or occluded by foreground apps
architecture: SensorEventListener / Touch Motion → OpenGL ES Render Loop → SurfaceHolder WallpaperService → Battery Guard Lifecycle Hooks
testingDetails: Publicly verified and published on Google Play under developer Tanmoy Majumder (Developer ID: 8946471561851740040).

name: NeoSketch
tagline: Offline AI-Powered Artistic Photo Editor for Android & Windows
summary: NeoSketch is a privacy-first, offline image processing and artistic filter application. Built with a cross-platform Flutter UI connected via native Dart FFI to a Rust core executing ONNX neural network models entirely on-device without cloud dependencies.
highlights: 100% offline on-device neural style transfer and image enhancement
Zero cloud data transfers — photos never leave the user's hardware
High-speed zero-copy memory bridge between Dart and Rust native shared libraries
Hardware acceleration using NNAPI on Android and DirectML on Windows
architecture: Flutter Canvas UI → Dart FFI Foreign Interface → Rust Processing Core → ONNX Inference Runtime (NNAPI/DirectML) → Framebuffer Output
testingDetails: Open source research project verifying local neural inference performance across mobile and desktop chipsets.

name: Vortyx
tagline: Modern Android Media Downloader & Download Manager
summary: Vortyx is a high-performance Android media download manager engineered with modern Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Features a clean Material 3 interface, concurrent multi-threaded downloads, smart file categorization, and resumable transfer management.
highlights: Material 3 dynamic theming interface with fluid Compose animations
Resumable multi-threaded chunked downloads with pause and retry support
Automated categorization into Video, Audio, Image, and Document directories
Background processing managed via Android Jetpack WorkManager
architecture: Jetpack Compose UI → ViewModel & StateFlow → Download Dispatcher Service (WorkManager) → OkHttp HTTP Client → Scoped Storage SAF
testingDetails: Active open source repository on GitHub under Tcode-Motion/Vortyx.

name: CloudVault
tagline: Encrypted Android Cloud Storage Experience Powered by Telegram TDLib
summary: CloudVault leverages Telegram's distributed cloud infrastructure via the TDLib native client library to provide a secure personal drive interface with folder navigation, chunked uploads, and local offline caching.
highlights: Custom drive abstraction layer over Telegram protocol messages
Large file streaming and automatic chunk segmentation
Local metadata indexing and search powered by Room Database
Offline file caching with intelligent disk quota pruning
architecture: Jetpack Compose UI → Repository Pattern → TDLib Native JNI Wrapper → Telegram MTProto Infrastructure
testingDetails: Proof of concept verifying infinite object storage abstraction over messaging protocol architectures.
